about: Editorial decisions applied on top of the verified transcription by scripts/build-ff1-exams.mjs. Keys are <exam>-<printed question number>. Nothing here changes a stem, a choice, or an answer letter; it attaches illustration assets, adds review notes, and can hold an item out of scored tests.

i1: Printed pages 4, 26, 46, 48, 68, 72, 78, 84, 86, 112, 114, and 142 were not scanned. Joseph confirmed from the physical book on 2026-11-04 that all twelve are blank.
Key entries 76 and 77 are headed 6.3.02 but their Reference lines print NFPA 1010, 6.3.3; entry 19's Jones and Bartlett citation ends at the word "page" with no page number. Both are kept as printed.
i2: The directions on printed page 27 and the Answer Form reference are the book's own wording.
Key entries 30 to 73 are headed 6.3.08 but their Reference lines print NFPA 1010, 6.3.10, and entry 147 is headed 6.3.12 with a 6.3.11 Reference line. Kept as printed.
i3: The directions on printed page 49 refer to the Answer Form for the Firefighter I-2 Examination, as printed.
Key entry 84 prints its Reference line as NFPA 1010, 6.18 and entry 114 as 6.3,20; entries 117 to 122 print the topic as AIR MONITORNG. Kept as printed.
Question 106 depends on the knot drawing printed on page 61. A crop of the book's own figure from the scan is attached, not a redrawing.

illustration.alt: A boxed line drawing of one rope running diagonally from lower left to upper right, both free ends drawn as arrowheads, with two stacked interlocking loops forming a doubled, twisted knot body in the middle.
